purpose: Pins the one head form the second live run raised on: a notice heading wrapped over two centred lines, both beginning with a marker phrase ('AVIS A MANIFESTATION D’INTERET EN VUE D’UNE' over 'DEMANDE DE PROPOSITIONS ALLEGEE'). The page has a complete head above it - section line, buyer, blank, title - so the rule the normaliser states is that a centred phrase line directly beneath a marker line is that heading's continuation, not a second notice. One page is enough: its own footer prints the issue stamp the published_at rule reads.
